name: webexApprovalGate
description: Interactive Webex approval gate. 1) posts a 'proceed / stop' question to the Webex room (via webexNotifyMigration); 2) waits for the inbound 'webex-approval' CloudEvent carrying the user's reply { text, personEmail }; 3) if the reply matches proceed|approve|continue|yes|go => returns decision=proceed and the caller advances; any other reply (incl. 'stop'/'no') re-notifies 'HELD' and loops back to waiting, so the workflow stays paused at the gate until the user later replies 'proceed'. REQUIRES a Webex->CWM webhook/bot that emits the 'webex-approval' event, correlated to this run.

definition.name: webexApprovalGate

metadata.note: Posts the proceed/stop question to Webex and waits for the human reply.

stateDataFilter.input: ${ . + { notifyStatus: "AWAITING DECISION \u2014 reply 'proceed' to continue or 'stop' to hold" } }

metadata.note: Blocks until a Webex reply arrives as the 'webex-approval' event (posted by the Webex bot/webhook).
Reply was 'stop'/'no'/unrecognized. Workflow HELD at this gate; re-notifies and waits again for a later 'proceed'.

stateDataFilter.input: ${ . + { notifyStatus: "STOPPED / HELD \u2014 workflow paused at this gate. Reply 'proceed' on Webex when ready to continue to the next phase." } }
